module.purpose: Shim module bridging the react-reconciler's module-based host config expectation with a host config object injected as a function argument ($$$config) in the published npm bundle, re-exporting its properties and declaring opaque Flow types for third-party renderers.
module.summary: This file is a pure binding shim with no executable logic. It declares Flow opaque types for host-specific concepts (Instance, Container, etc.) and re-exports every host config field from the injected $$$config object as named ES module exports. The exports are grouped into sections: core renderer metadata, mandatory lifecycle hooks, and optional capabilities (microtasks, test selectors, mutation, persistence, hydration, resources, singletons). It allows the reconciler internals to import a static host config module while the actual implementation is supplied by the consuming renderer at bundle-wrap time.
module.businessContext: Enables third-party React renderers to plug into react-reconciler via a configurable host interface. If broken, custom renderers cannot link to the reconciler and fail to operate.
